Crest Trust Services operates as Crest Trust Holdings Inc., a fiduciary services firm based in Centurion that has worked in the fiduciary industry since 1 July 2005. The firm was founded to provide more personalised support to small and medium enterprise clients as well as high-net-worth individuals, combining legal and fiduciary expertise with day-to-day estate administration.

Crest Trust assists individuals, families, business owners and trustees with estate planning, the establishment and administration of trusts, drafting of wills, and the administration of deceased estates, alongside tax-related guidance to keep client affairs compliant and aligned with their wishes. Its services extend to maintaining accurate trust records, trustee resolutions and decision trails, keeping beneficial-ownership and transparency records, and providing practical guidance on FICA-aligned client onboarding and ongoing updates. The firm positions itself as a long-standing partner that helps clients put the right structures in place before a crisis occurs, rather than only stepping in once an estate needs to be wound up. Being based in Centurion places Crest Trust within easy reach of clients throughout the greater Pretoria area who need fiduciary, estate planning or trust administration support from a single, established provider.

Cronos Rooihuiskraal Plumbers & Electricians is a combined plumbing and electrical services business operating in and around Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, as listed on the Procompare services directory. Its plumbing side covers blocked drains, general plumbing services, water leak detection, and geyser installation and repair, while its electrical side covers house wiring, electrical repairs, electrical wiring, and emergency electrician call-outs. The business also issues electrical certificates of compliance, a legally required document for property sales and insurance purposes in South Africa.

By combining both trades under one business, Cronos Rooihuiskraal is positioned to handle household issues that often overlap, such as geyser faults that involve both plumbing and electrical work, without a customer needing to call two separate contractors. Operating from the Rooihuiskraal area gives it convenient reach into the surrounding Centurion suburbs for both routine maintenance work and emergency call-outs. The business is listed among other home-service providers serving the greater Centurion area on the Procompare platform, where customers can view its profile alongside similar plumbing and electrical contractors operating in the region.

items.description:
Cut to Size has been crafting kitchens and custom woodwork from its Mayville premises since 1995. The business cuts and edges melamine, veneer, MDF and chipboard, using scoring blades, a technique employing two blades, to produce a chip-free finish on each cut. Its trained team works with customers to translate kitchen designs into finished cabinetry, and its portfolio spans bespoke cabinetry and kitchen installations through to commercial interiors and signage.

Beyond cutting boards to size, the company's offering includes bringing full kitchen projects to life, from material selection through to the finished installed product, with staff available to guide customers through the options for their specific design. Having operated in Mayville, Pretoria for three decades, the business has built up experience across both small, once-off cutting jobs for home renovators and larger commercial fit-out projects. Its location in Mayville, within reach of central Pretoria, makes it a convenient stop for furniture makers, shopfitters, and homeowners needing board materials cut and edged to precise specifications without needing to transport raw sheets far from where the work will be installed.

Dadas Shoe Shop is a footwear retailer located at 7 Mogul Street in the Asiatic Bazaar area of Marabastad, Pretoria. The shop stocks footwear for men, women and children, spanning casual, formal and sporting styles, aiming to offer a broad enough selection that most family members can find something suitable in one visit. In addition to cash, the store accepts card payments and NFC mobile payments, giving customers several convenient ways to pay at the till.

The shop maintains a wheelchair-accessible entrance and wheelchair-accessible parking, making it accessible to a wider range of customers visiting the Asiatic Bazaar shopping area. It trades six days a week, Monday to Saturday, from 8:30 in the morning to 5:30 in the afternoon, closing on Sundays. Its position within the Asiatic Bazaar, one of Pretoria's older and more established retail and trading districts, places Dadas Shoe Shop among a cluster of other independent retailers, giving shoppers in the area a nearby, family-oriented option for everyday and occasion footwear without needing to travel to one of the city's larger shopping malls.

De Vries Carpentry is a carpentry business operating from Raslouw, offering custom woodwork built around decades of hands-on experience in the trade. The business describes its core values as quality, craftsmanship and customer satisfaction, with its team working under close guidance to produce custom carpentry solutions tailored to each client's needs. Its work centres on detailed interior woodwork such as skirting and architraves, the kind of finishing carpentry that shapes the look of a room's doors, walls and staircases.

The company positions honesty, integrity and innovation as guiding principles in how it approaches each job, aiming to translate a customer's carpentry requirements into a finished product that matches their original vision. Being based in Raslouw gives De Vries Carpentry convenient access to the surrounding Centurion area, allowing it to serve homeowners and builders working on renovations or new-build finishing throughout the district. The business invites prospective customers to make contact to discuss their specific carpentry project, reflecting a made-to-order approach rather than a fixed, off-the-shelf product range typical of larger furniture retailers.

DeGraaf Exhausts is a performance exhaust manufacturer based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, with a history the company describes as spanning 65 years in the industry. The business designs and manufactures exhaust systems aimed at vehicle enthusiasts looking to improve performance rather than simply replace a worn-out factory exhaust. DeGraaf positions its systems as delivering power gains and torque gains, improved throttle response, reduced turbo lag, lower exhaust gas temperatures, and additional headroom for further performance upgrades, while also aiming to improve fuel economy compared with a stock exhaust setup.

The company presents itself as a pioneering force in the local performance exhaust industry, crediting its long operating history with having set benchmarks that it continues to build on. Its customer base is described as decision-makers who take a bold and nonconformist approach to modifying their vehicles. Operating out of Hermanstad places DeGraaf within Pretoria's established industrial manufacturing belt, giving it practical access to the metalworking skills and suppliers needed to design and build exhaust systems in-house rather than simply importing and reselling third-party parts.

Dentist & Optometrist Wonderpark, also known as Optodent, is a combined dental and optometry practice operating from Shop 134 in the Wonderpark Shopping Centre in Karenpark, Pretoria. According to the practice's own Facebook page, it describes itself as a newly established practice within the centre, covering a wide range of optometry services.

Housing dental and eye-care services under one roof means patients visiting the practice for a dental appointment can also arrange optometry needs, such as eye tests or spectacles, in the same shopping trip, without travelling to a separate practice elsewhere in Pretoria North. The practice has used its Facebook page to share promotions, such as past offers on computer glasses with blue-light-blocking lenses aimed at people who spend long hours in front of screens. Being located inside Wonderpark Shopping Centre, on the corner of Brits Road and Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark, gives the practice convenient footfall from shoppers in the centre and easy access for residents of Karenpark and the wider Akasia area seeking dental or eye-care services close to home.

Drip Gear, trading on Instagram as @drip_gearsa, is a Pretoria-based clothing brand operating out of Eersterust that describes itself as "Home To Nostalgic Football Kits." The brand focuses on retro-style football jerseys and related apparel, drawing on nostalgia for older kit designs rather than current-season replicas.

Its Instagram presence, which had built up more than 1,600 followers at the time of research, is used to showcase new arrivals, community content, and pop-up events where customers can view and buy stock in person rather than only online. The brand has also run themed content built around "a 90s thing," reflecting its focus on vintage and throwback football style, along with competitions for its followers. Operating from Eersterust, a residential suburb to the east of Pretoria, Drip Gear relies heavily on social media and pop-up appearances to reach customers across the city rather than operating from a conventional retail storefront. For customers interested in football culture and retro fashion, the brand offers a niche alternative to mainstream sportswear retailers, built around a specific and recognisable aesthetic.

Dynamic Mobile Trailer, trading as Dynamics Mobile Trailers (Pty) Ltd and owned by Dynamics Holdings, is a South African trailer manufacturer based in the Kameeldrift and Roodeplaat area of Pretoria. The company designs, builds and supplies a range of purpose-built mobile trailers, describing its approach as combining honesty, reliability and quality across every project it takes on, serving industrial, commercial and residential customers in both the private and public sectors.

Its product range includes mobile kitchens fully equipped for food vending, catering and street food use, stage trailers built for concerts, festivals and outdoor events, and animal trailers designed for the safe transport of livestock, pets and farm animals. The company also builds camping trailers aimed at comfortable mobile living for travel and outdoor adventures, as well as hearse trailers designed for the dignified transportation of coffins during funeral services. Being based in the Kameeldrift area on the northern edge of Pretoria gives Dynamics Mobile Trailers workshop space suited to trailer manufacturing, while keeping it within reach of clients across the greater Pretoria and Gauteng region who need a trailer built to a specific purpose rather than bought off a general dealer's lot.

Eco Tanks Rosslyn is a rainwater tank supplier based in Klerksoord AH, Akasia, offering a range of durable tanks for rainwater harvesting, including 5000-litre models suited to household or small-scale use. Customers can shop in-store at the Klerksoord premises or arrange delivery for orders that need to be dropped off elsewhere, with credit card payments accepted alongside other usual methods.

The business emphasises durability and cost-effectiveness in its product range, aiming to give customers clear guidance on which tank size and type suits their particular water-storage needs. The premises offer wheelchair-accessible parking, making the site easier to reach for a wider range of customers collecting tanks in person. With rainwater harvesting becoming more common among Pretoria households looking to reduce reliance on municipal water supply, particularly during periods of load shedding or water restrictions, a dedicated local supplier such as Eco Tanks gives residents of Akasia and the surrounding Pretoria North area a nearby source for tanks without needing to order from a supplier based elsewhere in Gauteng and wait for long-distance delivery.

items.description:
Egyptian Foiling & Printing is a printing company based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, specialising in foiling, embossing and laser cutting rather than standard bulk printing. The business describes its approach as blending traditional and contemporary printing methods, aiming to elevate a client's brand through finishing techniques that add texture and visual interest to printed material, such as foil accents or raised embossed detail.

Equipped with laser cutting technology alongside its foiling and embossing capability, the company can produce more intricate cut designs than conventional die-cutting would allow, making it suited to branding and packaging work where a distinctive finish matters. The company positions itself as a destination for clients who need printing finished to a decorative, premium standard rather than plain, everyday print runs. Operating from Koedoespoort Industrial places Egyptian Foiling & Printing within one of Pretoria's established industrial and manufacturing areas, giving it practical access to the kind of specialised printing and finishing equipment that this type of work requires, while remaining within reach of design agencies and brand owners based across the greater Pretoria area.

Elecfence is an electric fencing contractor based in Weavind Park, serving both Pretoria and Centurion with residential, commercial, estate and rural installations. The company installs electric fencing across a range of configurations, including 8-line, 20-line, 24-line and 32-line systems, as well as 11-line skirt fencing that complements a larger existing installation. Its 8-line fencing is most commonly installed at residential properties, while 20-line systems are typically used on rural properties such as farms and smallholdings, and 32-line, galvanised omega-bracket fencing is aimed at commercial sites.

Beyond new installations, Elecfence offers repair and maintenance services for existing electric fences, including replacing faulty line brackets, lines and energisers, along with fault-finding call-outs for installations that have stopped working correctly. The company describes itself as experienced and affordable, aiming to get a faulty fence back online quickly once a problem has been traced. Being based in Weavind Park gives Elecfence convenient reach across both Pretoria and neighbouring Centurion, allowing it to service residential estates, rural properties and commercial sites throughout the wider metro without being limited to a single suburb.

items.description:
Energyweb specialises in insulation solutions for residential, commercial and agricultural properties, operating from Florauna in the Boekenhoutskloof area of Pretoria. The company's products are aimed at helping households and businesses maintain more comfortable indoor temperatures year-round while reducing electricity costs associated with heating and cooling. Its range includes ceiling insulation for homes and commercial buildings, foil insulation products, agricultural insulation suited to farm structures, and geyser blankets that reduce the standing heat loss from a hot water cylinder, along with heat-reflective insulation products designed to boost a property's overall energy performance.

Energyweb positions its products as supporting a more sustainable lifestyle by cutting unnecessary energy use rather than simply adding comfort, framing insulation as a practical response to rising electricity costs. The company publishes guidance for customers on its site, including material addressing whether roof insulation genuinely saves money, suggesting an emphasis on helping customers understand the value of the investment before committing. Being based in the Boekenhoutskloof and Florauna area of Pretoria places Energyweb within reach of both Pretoria East's established residential suburbs and the city's surrounding agricultural smallholdings that make up part of its customer base.

Engineering Dynamics (Pty) Ltd is a machine-condition-monitoring specialist based in the Lynnwood area of Pretoria. The company focuses on laser shaft alignment, vibration analysis, field balancing and calibration services aimed at improving the reliability of industrial machinery. Alongside its service offering, Engineering Dynamics runs hands-on training in these disciplines, with instructors providing practical guidance on the equipment used so that client staff gain both the confidence and the technical skill to apply the techniques themselves.

The company operates a local calibration centre, positioning this as a faster and more affordable alternative to sending equipment overseas for calibration, while still delivering locally produced, reliable results. It describes having held established relationships with multiple award-winning equipment manufacturers for more than three decades, which it presents as evidence of a long-standing, trusted position in the local condition-monitoring industry. For industrial clients across Pretoria and the wider Gauteng region, having a local specialist offering alignment, vibration and balancing training alongside calibration services reduces the need to rely on equipment manufacturers or overseas providers for routine machine-reliability work.

Epol's Pretoria Mill, located in Pretoria Industrial in the Proclamation Hill area, forms part of Epol's national animal feed manufacturing network, with the company having supplied animal nutrition products since 1916. Epol produces feed across most livestock and farming species, supplying both in bulk and in bags directly to farmers, as well as through a wide network of partner resellers who stock its bagged products.

Across its mills nationally, including the Pretoria facility, Epol's product range covers dairy, game, horse, ostrich, pig, broiler, layer, general ruminant, beef cattle, sheep and goat feeds, with regional demand determining which specific products a given mill prioritises for its local market. Where a farmer's needs fall outside the standard product range, Epol also produces custom feed mixes to suit individual requirements, subject to minimum order quantities. The company positions its mills, including the Pretoria operation, as part of a long-established national supply network built up over more than a century, aiming to be a farmer's first choice for animal nutrition rather than one option among many smaller regional feed producers.

Erasmus Rekenmeesters is an accounting and tax advisory practice based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, that describes itself as assisting clients with accounting, tax and business advice since 1979. The firm uses the phrase "heartbeat of the entrepreneur" to describe its role, positioning itself as a long-term adviser that protects and grows the value of a client's business rather than only handling once-off compliance work.

Its website sets out its services and makes useful documentation available to clients, alongside a blog covering accounting-related topics, including pieces on the history of accounting and notices of important tax and filing dates through the year. Having operated continuously in Pretoria since 1979, the firm has built up decades of experience working with entrepreneurs and established businesses alike on their accounting and tax affairs. Being based in Erasmusrand, within the Rigel Park office development, places Erasmus Rekenmeesters within easy reach of businesses throughout Pretoria East, giving local entrepreneurs access to an accounting practice with a long operating history in the area rather than a newly established one.

eSoftware Solutions, trading under the name eS3, positions itself as an AI transformation partner based in Waterkloof Park, Pretoria, drawing on what it describes as sixteen years of institutional delivery experience across Africa. Rather than simply implementing off-the-shelf AI tools, the company frames its work as architecting intelligence, helping organisations fundamentally rethink how they create value, make decisions and serve the people who depend on them.

Its stated service offerings include AI strategy development, AI programme and project management, AI agent implementation, AI capability development, and ongoing managed services for organisations that have adopted AI systems. The company describes itself as the only firm on the continent able to credibly combine advanced AI capability with deep African delivery heritage, built specifically for African institutions rather than adapted from an overseas framework. Based in Waterkloof Park, the company is positioned to support clients with work that spans the full lifecycle of an AI initiative, from initial strategy and governance through to building the internal capability an organisation needs to sustain AI use once a programme is up and running.

Esterhuizen Coaching and Consulting Services, trading as ECCSA, is an industrial psychology and leadership consultancy based in Eldoraigne, Centurion. The firm works with organisations to build what it calls future-ready leadership, talent and human capability, helping leaders make more defensible talent decisions and helping teams work towards a shared purpose rather than fragmented activity. Its coaching services include business coaching, executive coaching and team coaching, with a particular focus on Enneagram-based coaching methods, alongside work on building mental toughness in individuals and teams.

On the consulting side, ECCSA offers management consulting services aimed at organisations navigating leadership transitions, scarce skills and changing employee expectations, including the growing effect of AI-enabled work on how organisations operate. The firm also supports bursary, graduate and learnership programmes, helping organisations develop structured solutions for bringing in and developing new talent. ECCSA frames its core purpose as connecting people to purpose, arguing that capability without a clear sense of purpose becomes fragmented, while purpose alone cannot create performance without the capability to execute it. Operating from Eldoraigne gives the practice a base within Centurion from which to serve organisations across the greater Pretoria region.

Excel Business Institute is a corporate training and consulting company operating since 2015, based at 484 Hilda Street in Hatfield, within reach of the Bryntirion area of Pretoria. The institute focuses on technology and IT solutions training, working alongside companies as a hands-on partner to help solve everyday business challenges by developing staff's human capital and technical skills. Its scheduled course offerings include Microsoft Office training, such as introductory and intermediate Microsoft PowerPoint courses, run from its Hatfield premises on set dates throughout the year at fixed per-course pricing.

Alongside Microsoft Office and other technology courses, the institute covers project management and broader business and information technology training aimed at both individual professionals and corporate teams looking to upskill staff. The company publishes articles aimed at professionals, including guidance on how skills such as emotional intelligence, communication and adaptability can support career progression alongside technical ability. Having operated since 2015, Excel Business Institute has built up a base of corporate clients across South Africa, offering a Hatfield-based alternative to larger national training providers for companies in and around Pretoria needing structured technology and business-skills training.

Fair Price's Jubilee Mall branch in Hammanskraal is part of the FAIR PRICE Group, a furniture, appliance and electronics retail chain founded in 1999 to provide affordable, practical home products. The group operates on a principle it calls "The Fair Price Way," built around the belief that everyone deserves a comfortable, well-furnished home, and says it supports employment and entrepreneurship through innovation and collaboration across its operations.

Nationally, FAIR PRICE runs around 100 stores alongside 11 warehouses and two manufacturing sites, giving the Hammanskraal branch access to the group's wider furniture and appliance supply chain rather than operating as an independent, standalone store. The Jubilee Mall branch trades long hours through the week, opening at 9:00 in the morning and closing between 5:00 and 6:00 in the evening on weekdays, with shorter Saturday and Sunday trading hours. Located inside Jubilee Mall on Harry Gwala Avenue, the branch serves Hammanskraal and the surrounding areas with household furniture, appliances and electronics, giving local shoppers a nearby option for larger household purchases without needing to travel into central Pretoria.

FALKSON TENTS is a Pretoria-based retailer of canvas tents and camping equipment, based in the Andeon area near Pretoria Central. The business sells a range of all-weather canvas camping tents under its own Falkson and FVELDT product lines, including bow tents such as the four-person FALKSON Adventurer and three-person FVELDT Camper, as well as larger options like the five-person FVELDT Basecamp XT, which combines a bow tent with an extension, and the two-room, six-person FVELDT Family Camper aimed at bigger groups or families.

Alongside tents, the business stocks camping accessories needed to complete a camping setup, including roll-up camping mattresses and camping stretchers, positioning itself as a stop for outdoor gear beyond just the tent itself. Its broader range, referenced on its site, covers frame tents, gazebos, ground sheets, tent poles and tarpaulins, as well as tent pegs and hammers or mallets for pitching. Operating from Pretoria Central gives FALKSON TENTS a central location from which to serve camping and outdoor enthusiasts across the greater Pretoria area who need all-weather canvas tents rather than the lighter nylon tents found in many general outdoor retailers.

Ferna Kontrakteurs, operating in the Rooiwal and Annlin area of Pretoria, is a construction and shopfitting contractor that traces its origins back to 1995, when it started as a small operation with just three staff members. The business initially concentrated on projects in the Pretoria region before expanding into Johannesburg, and has since grown to take on larger contracts and countrywide work for a range of corporate clients. Ferna describes its approach as combining advanced construction techniques with a patented layered method that allows it to deliver complex designs, taking on turnkey projects where it manages a build from design through to completed, finished space.

The company has a particular focus on pilot shops for new retail roll-outs and on makeover and revamp projects, working closely with design companies on project management and implementation to achieve a client's intended outcome. Ferna Kontrakteurs is registered as a BEE contributor. Having grown from a three-person operation in 1995 into a countrywide contractor over three decades, the business combines long-standing construction experience with continued work on new store formats and refurbishment projects for corporate retail clients.

Fikisa Tech is a custom software development company based in Thatchfield, Centurion, built around a team with a combined skillset of more than ten years in the industry. The company's stated mission is to provide business solutions to its clients, with its core offering covering custom application and web development alongside search engine optimisation work to help client sites get found online.

Its services span custom software development aimed at optimising client workflows and automating repetitive tasks, mobile application development for businesses needing their own dedicated apps, and cloud application development built on Microsoft Azure, which the company uses to enable smoother cloud migration and reduce infrastructure costs for clients. Fikisa Tech's stated vision is to help emerging companies grow by making better use of digital platforms, framing its work as giving smaller or growing businesses the kind of digital tooling that might otherwise only be available to larger, established companies. Based in Thatchfield, the company serves clients across Centurion and the wider Pretoria region, offering a locally based alternative to larger software agencies for small and growing businesses needing custom-built digital tools.

Fintech Fundi is a technology company based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, that specialises in providing IT and software solutions to microfinance lenders. Its core product is a SaaS loan origination and management system, which the company says grew out of more than a decade of frustration with the limitations of existing products available to the micro-finance industry, including a lack of control over regulation-based calculations and inefficiencies in managing bad debt and loan portfolios. The system is built to handle compliance requirements specific to micro-finance lending, manage loan portfolios efficiently, and allow for customisation to suit individual lenders' internal processes, rather than forcing clients into a rigid, one-size-fits-all platform.

Beyond its loan management software, Fintech Fundi also supports its microfinance clients with broader IT needs, including desktop support, network setup, hardware acquisition, monthly software packages, firewalls and other security measures, positioning itself as a single point of contact for a microfinance business's technology requirements. Based in Erasmuskloof, the company works with small and medium-sized micro-finance enterprises, aiming to resolve the kind of IT and software problems that these lenders would otherwise need several different specialist suppliers to address.

Flexispace Centurion, based in Doringkloof, offers private, lockable serviced offices and isolation offices aimed at tenants who want the freedom to run their business without being tied into a traditional office lease. The company operates on a no-lease policy, allowing businesses to rent a private office on a daily, weekly, monthly or yearly basis, with staff available to handle reception and general office support so tenants can focus on running their own operations. Membership includes 24-hour access, free fibre internet and WiFi, professionally appointed meeting rooms, unlimited tea and coffee, backup power, and free parking, covering most of the practical needs of a small business or remote team.

Flexispace describes itself as South African owned and staffed, and in addition to its Doringkloof site in Centurion, it operates further locations at Eagle Canyon and Houghton Estate. Virtual office packages are also available for businesses that need a registered address and occasional access to meeting space without renting a dedicated office full time. Being based in Doringkloof places this branch within easy reach of businesses across Centurion needing flexible office space with security, backup power and no long-term lease commitment.

Franke & Associates Attorneys is a law firm based in the Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate in Centurion, listed on the Procompare professional-services directory as offering a broad general-practice offering rather than a single legal specialism. According to its directory profile, the firm's services cover corporate law, family law, conveyancing, labour law, divorce matters, commercial law and immigration law, giving it a client base that likely spans both individuals dealing with personal legal matters and businesses needing commercial or labour-related legal advice.

Operating as a general-practice firm with this range of specialisms allows Franke & Associates to act for a single client across different legal needs over time, from handling a property transfer through conveyancing to representing them in a family law or labour dispute, without the client needing to find a separate specialist firm for each matter. Being based within Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate places the firm within one of Centurion's established residential estates, giving it a base from which to serve both estate residents and clients across the wider Centurion and Pretoria area needing legal representation across a range of civil and commercial matters.

GD Granite Tombstones manufactures granite tombstones from its premises on the Bronkhorstspruit Road in Donkerhoek, offering customers the option to deal with the business directly from the factory rather than through an intermediary retailer. The company sets out clear terminology for customers unfamiliar with the different parts of a memorial, including the headstone, which carries the deceased's name, dates and a family message, the foot piece placed at the base of the headstone for a surname or short message, the ledger, a polished granite slab placed on the curbs that can also be inscribed, and the curb stone, which raises the ledger and frames the memorial.

The business invites customers to contact it directly for personal assistance and advice on choosing and ordering a tombstone at factory pricing, reflecting a made-to-order rather than off-the-shelf approach. Its site is organised around a simple catalogue and contact structure, consistent with a smaller, specialised manufacturer rather than a large multi-branch monument retailer. Being based at Donkerhoek, on the eastern outskirts of Pretoria, places the business near the quarries this type of stone is typically sourced from, within reach of families across the greater Pretoria region arranging a memorial.

General Food Safety Company, registered as General Food Safety Company Pty Ltd, is a certification and training business based in Kirkney, Pretoria, operating under the banner of "local conformance, global recognition." The company's stated service areas include ISO certification, safety audits, FSSAI-related work, energy audits and lead-auditor training, positioning it as a provider that works across food safety and broader quality-management certification rather than a single narrow niche.

Its site structure covers its certification process and policies, the certifications it serves, and a request-a-quote facility for prospective clients wanting to engage its services, alongside a client login area for existing customers to manage their accreditation relationship with the company. By offering lead-auditor training alongside certification and audit services, General Food Safety Company positions itself to help client organisations build internal auditing capacity rather than relying solely on external audits for ongoing compliance. Being based in Kirkney gives the company a base within Pretoria from which to serve food manufacturers and other certification clients across the city and wider region, supporting businesses that need to demonstrate compliance with recognised international food safety and quality standards to their own customers or regulators.

Genesis Projects & Services, a division of the Genesis Group of Companies, is a labour-driven organisation based in Theresapark that specialises in placing permanent, temporary and contract staff with client businesses. Alongside staff placement, the company runs a Registered Labour Brokerage Service, which includes managing contracts with placed workers, handling statutory deductions, managing industrial relations matters, and providing labour advisory services to client companies navigating South Africa's labour regulations.

The company notes that it was rated among the Top 100 Suppliers in the Motor Industry in 2008 by NAAMSA's OEM BBBEE Preferential Procurement Subcommittee, pointing to an established track record supplying staffing services to automotive-sector clients specifically. Its core service offering covers contract staff, permanent staff, temporary staff, payroll administration and management, and labour advisory services, giving client companies a single point of contact for both sourcing staff and managing the compliance side of employing them. Being based in Theresapark, in Pretoria North, gives Genesis Projects & Services a base within reach of the industrial and manufacturing employers across that part of the city who typically rely most heavily on flexible, temporary and contract staffing arrangements.

GHOST South Africa, based in Doringkloof, Centurion, sells a range of vehicle anti-theft systems built around a once-off purchase rather than an ongoing subscription. The company markets its products as warranty-friendly, since installation requires no cutting, splicing, joining or rewiring of the vehicle's existing wiring, and emphasises that there are no monthly fees once a system has been fitted, in contrast to subscription-based tracking or alarm services. Its product range includes the Ghost X and Ghost Plus arming systems, with Ghost Plus using a two-part arming system intended to double security, as well as Ghost Xtra Safe, developed specifically for the GD6-generation Toyota Hilux and Fortuner, two of the most commonly targeted vehicles for theft in South Africa. The company also offers Ghost Track, aimed at vehicle tracking to improve recovery chances and visibility if a vehicle is stolen, and Ghost NXT, which uses Bluetooth disarming as part of a total shutdown approach.

GHOST offers mobile fitment, sending installers to the customer rather than requiring a workshop visit. Operating from Doringkloof gives the company a base in Centurion from which to serve vehicle owners across the greater Pretoria region.

Gift a Gift is an online personalised gift shop operating out of Heuweloord, Pretoria, specialising in customised books and other made-to-order personalised items rather than off-the-shelf gifts. Its signature product line lets customers create a storybook in which their own child appears as the hero or heroine of the tale, incorporating personal details such as the child's name, surname, hometown and the names of friends or family members into the finished story, alongside illustrated artwork built around those details. Beyond children's storybooks, the business also sells personalised items for adults, including a seven-piece personalised apron set marketed around Father's Day and summer braai occasions.

Each personalised product is produced only once an order has been placed and the customer's details supplied, reflecting a made-to-order production process rather than stocked inventory. The company's online store is organised around its various book and gift ranges, with options to track an order and manage an account once a purchase has been made. Operating from Heuweloord, on the southern side of Pretoria, Gift a Gift relies on its online store and courier delivery to reach customers across the city and beyond, rather than depending on walk-in retail trade from a physical shopfront.

Glenstantia Veterinary Clinic is a veterinary practice based on Thelma Martin Street in Garsfontein, Pretoria East, offering a broad range of services covering preventative, medical, dental, surgical and senior-pet care. Its preventative and general care offering includes routine check-ups and wellness exams, vaccinations and parasite control, microchipping, and nutritional advice and weight management for pets. On the medical and diagnostic side, the clinic runs in-house laboratory testing, digital x-rays and ultrasound imaging, bloodwork and advanced diagnostics, and allergy testing and treatment, and it maintains a hospitalisation area with an isolation ward for pets that need to be kept in.

Its dental service covers professional cleaning, tooth extractions, oral surgery and gum disease treatment, while its surgical offering spans general and soft-tissue surgery, sterilisations, orthopaedic surgery, and emergency and critical care. The clinic also provides specialised services such as wing clipping for birds, puppy and kitten wellness programmes, behavioural consultations, and end-of-life care, alongside senior-pet programmes addressing arthritis and pain management and chronic disease monitoring.

A small in-house veterinary shop sells pet accessories, toys, food and treats, including specialised prescription diets. The clinic works mainly on an appointment basis, though emergencies are seen without one.
